records.rationale: The global MIDI Learn switch needs aria-disabled (not the native disabled attribute) so its own title tooltip keeps working while gated off a supported destination -- a genuinely disabled button suppresses hover/focus events in Chromium/WebView2, silently swallowing the tooltip. No existing primitive combines an icon+text label with that soft-disabled toggle contract (IconButton has disabledBehavior="soft" but hides its text label; Button has no soft-disabled mode at all).
records.reviewCondition: a shared icon+label toggle primitive with soft-disabled support is added to the design system

records.rationale: The active-state accent ring around the toggle once MIDI Learn is on -- box-shadow has no longhand decomposition, so this shorthand mixing raw geometry with a semantic color token (inside color-mix() for translucency) can never satisfy DS001's bare-var()/calc(var()) pattern, the same reasoning as Desk's own desk-fader-learn-hit-area-focus-shadow exception.
records.reviewCondition: a focus-ring/accent-ring box-shadow token is added to the design system
